text:
anya: quick one  we need a clear mapping from profile 'hardness' to canary length/traffic. too many ad-hoc canaries right now.

matt: agreed. propose default mapping: low=1hr@1%, medium=4hr@5%, high=24hr@10% (and require manual signoff for >10% or >24hr).

priya: +1 but add a "shadow-eval" requirement for high hardness when fp8 involved. shadow eval must run on the release branch against the quality_anchor and report pass/fail.
sam: also add automated rollback triggers: e.g., token-level latency increase >15% OR quality-drop >max_degradation in profile -> auto-revert to previous variant. we should keep thresholds configurable per-customer tier.

anya: can we encode this in the profile DSL? something like:
```yaml
profile:
  model: mixtral-8x
  hardness: high
  requires_shadow_eval: true
  canary:
    duration: 24h
    start_traffic: 0.1
    max_traffic_without_signoff: 0.1
  rollback_triggers:
    latency_pct: 15
    degradation_pct: 3
```

matt: that looks good. lint should surface missing canary when hardness=high, and runtime admission should refuse deploy if requires_shadow_eval is true but no shadow job exists.

priya: a few edge cases: long-context workloads need longer warmup windows for kv-cache. maybe an additional field canary_warmup_tokens or warmup_duration.
sam: ops will need to map hardness->canary policy per-customer tier. e.g., enterprise customers get shorter canary but stricter rollback. document in playbook.

anya: question on UI: show an estimated cost of canary (GPU-hours) and a "risk score" computed from hardness + allowed_precisions mix. helps PMs decide.
matt: risk_score formula idea: base_score(hardness) + fp8_penalty + headwise_mix_penalty - shadow_eval_bonus. keep it simple for now.

priya: ops automation: when canary completes, runtime should POST a summary with metrics and verdict, we then auto-promote or require manual signoff depending on thresholds. keep audit trail.

ci-bot: created issue #1350: "standardize hardness->canary mapping + shadow eval requirement" (assignee: anya).

sam: action items: priya to draft shadow-eval checklist, matt to add UI mock for canary cost/risk, anya to update DSL and lint rules.

anya: one more rule: ban increasing start_traffic above max_traffic_without_signoff unless signoff is recorded. makes accidental large rollouts harder.

matt: noted. I'll add a GH action that fails if PR increases canary start_traffic above previous value without a signoff commit message.

priya: I'll prototype a small shadow-eval job and attach example output shape for runtime admission.

ci-bot: precision-policy-bot published v0.3 with canary policy hooks.
